content:
Advise you compact when you know you are not downloading, also advise when compacting, you do not select anything, just wait and do not exit Thunderbird whilst it's occurring. It should only take a few moments. Info should be seen in the bottom Status bar.

If you still have a problem, Suggest you access the Anti-Virus and set up an exclusion to not scan anything in your Thunderbird folder that contains all the Profile name folders etc.

  • eg: C://Users/username/Appdata/Roaming/Thunderbird
creator: Toad-Hall

content:
Sounds like you are using the Dark theme. So try this first.

  • Menu app icon (3 lines) > 'Add-ons and Themes'
  • Select 'Themes'
  • enable the 'Light' theme.
